summary: Pembina filed a Form 6-K covering news that Ottawa designated the West Coast Oil Pipeline, renamed Pacific Link, a Project of National Interest under the Building Canada Act. Pembina holds a 10% construction-period economic interest, with an option for up to 10% more once commercial, retains full FID discretion, and committed no at-risk capital pre-FID. Trans Mountain Corporation leads regulatory process, Indigenous engagement, construction, and operations; the Major Projects Office oversees review, supported by the Canada Energy Regulator. No transaction terms, price, or board recommendation were disclosed. Watch for FID timing and any partnership economics.
